description: Source code for LIN interface implementation in an AUTOSAR-based automotive software platform, including initialization, sleep/wake management, scheduling, and communication handling.

methods.name: LinIf_Init
methods.description: Initializes LIN interface, driver, and channels based on configuration.

methods.name: LinIf_Transmit
methods.description: Handles transmission requests; currently supports only acknowledgment of transmission.

methods.name: LinIf_ScheduleRequest
methods.description: Requests a new schedule for a specific LIN channel.

methods.name: LinIf_GotoSleep
methods.description: Transitions a LIN channel to sleep mode.

methods.name: LinIf_WakeUp
methods.description: Wakes up a LIN channel from sleep mode.

methods.name: LinIf_MainFunction
methods.description: Main periodic function managing scheduling, sleep/wake transitions, and communication.
